metadata.description: Hooks, plugins, and MCP servers for AI coding agents

plugins.name: quota-watch
plugins.description: Adaptive Claude Max quota monitor; emits context at warn/halt thresholds and auto-schedules a wake after the 5h reset.

plugins.name: plan-project
plugins.description: Turns a settled architecture into a dispatch-ready workplan: phase-tagged tasks, paired tests, deterministic runbooks, and a graph the orchestrator can fan out from.

plugins.name: orchestrate-workplan
plugins.description: Drives a workplan to completion on a cheap, fast model. Mandatory TodoWrite for rails, deterministic runbook gates, more-capable verifier subagent on failure, architecture validator at phase boundaries.

plugins.name: claude-tee
plugins.description: Tees every UserPromptSubmit to a local JSONL archive plus optional SSE/HTTP fan-out. Personal prompt archive, transcript mirror, or pipeline source. Blocking the model after capture is an opt-in debug flag.
